purpose: First-party facts from Brother's 1634D product page, the family handbook, and the US and international serger warranty PDFs, compared against data/specs/brother-1634d.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Image-only PDF, OCR; names the 1634D only in the foot controller note (KD-1902); family values for speed, weight, needles, stitch width
The PDF the product page links as its warranty; states 1 year

site.label: Speed
site.juki: 1,300 stitches per minute on Brother's page and in the family handbook.

facts.value: Bulb (page Lighting Type); handbook names a replaceable lamp
facts.note: Spec holds no lighting value. The 1034DX has LED; the 1634D page says bulb.

site.label: Work light
site.juki: A bulb, per Brother's page. The 1034DX has an LED.

facts.value: 3 or 4 thread, two needles; page spec '2/3/4 Thread Change: No' (no 2-thread stitch); handbook 'Three/Four threads convertible'
facts.source: brother-page Features and Serger table; brother-handbook spec page

site.label: Thread modes
site.juki: 3 or 4 thread with two needles. The page says no 2/3/4 thread change, so there is no 2-thread stitch.

facts.value: Page: overlock seam width 5.0 to 7.0 mm from the left needle. Handbook: 2.3 to 7 mm (two-needle), 3.0 to 3.5 mm (one-needle)
facts.source: brother-page Serger table; brother-handbook spec page
facts.note: Spec 5 to 7 matches the 1634D page. The family handbook gives a wider range for two-needle models.

site.label: Stitch width
site.juki: 5.0 to 7.0 mm on the 1634D page. The family handbook lists 2.3 to 7 mm for two-needle models.
site.others: A review blog says 5 to 7 mm.

facts.note: Family handbook; the manual lists 1634D with the foot controller note.

facts.value: 5 to 6 mm (page also: adjustable presser foot pressure, Yes)
facts.source: brother-handbook spec page; brother-page Basic Features
facts.note: Spec holds null. The handbook is the family handbook, which names the 1634D only in the foot controller note.

site.label: Presser foot lift
site.juki: 5 to 6 mm per the family handbook. Brother's page lists adjustable presser foot pressure.

site.label: Needles
site.juki: SCHMETZ 130/705H, with a set of two size 80 and two size 90 per the family handbook.
site.others: A parts dealer lists the same system.

facts.value: Standard foot, blindstitch foot, gathering foot; soft cover, instructional video and printed manual in the copy
facts.spec_value: Standard foot, blind stitch foot, gathering foot; soft cover and instructional video

site.label: Feet in the box
site.juki: Standard, blindstitch and gathering feet, plus a soft cover. Brother says 3 included accessory feet.
site.others: Dealers list the same three feet.

facts.value: Not on Brother's 1634D page. Family handbook: net 7.0 kg (15.4 lb)
facts.note: Spec 17.3 lb comes from a review blog. The handbook is a family document (names 1634D only in the foot controller note); treat 15.4 lb as the family figure, not the 1634D's.

site.label: Weight
site.juki: Brother's 1634D page gives none. The family handbook says 7.0 kg net (15.4 lb).
site.others: A review blog says 17.3 lb, possibly shipping weight.

facts.value: Carton 15 x 13 x 14 in; machine dimensions not on Brother's page
facts.note: Brother lists only a carton size. The blog machine size has no stated axis order.

facts.value: Brother: 'color-coded lay-in threading'; Main Features: color-coded guides, fast lower loop threading
facts.note: One PatternReview owner says the 1634D lacks the color coding of the 1034D. Listed, not resolved.

site.label: Color-coded threading
site.juki: Brother's page says color-coded lay-in guides.
site.others: A PatternReview owner says the 1634D lacks the 1034D's color coding.

facts.value: Retractable knife blade, lower-drive knife, 1 stitch finger, removable trim trap, removable free arm
facts.note: One stitch finger matches the 1034D page; the PatternReview owner says the 1634D has two where the 1034D has one.

facts.value: Brother lists stitch types, no count
facts.note: Spec 22 is a blog figure; Brother publishes no count.

facts.value: Page label '1/5/25 Year Limited Serger Warranty' but the link is the International (Latin America and Caribbean) PDF, which states 1 year. The US Brother Limited Warranty (Serger) PDF states 1 year parts, labor and accessories, 5 years electronics (labor excluded), 25 years chassis casting
facts.note: Spec says 25-year limited. That term is the chassis casting only. The page links the international PDF; the US PDF carries the 1/5/25 terms.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 1 year parts, labor and accessories; 5 years electronic components; 25 years chassis casting (US PDF). The page's own link goes to an international PDF that says 1 year.

facts.note: Brother's 1034D page showed 319.99 on 2026-10-01, so the 1634D is listed $20 under it. Price band only; not a spec.

site.label: Price
site.juki: $299.99 at Brother USA on 2026-10-02. The 1034D was $319.99 there on 2026-10-01.
site.others: A 2019 forum post puts it at $154 at Walmart, stale.
